scoring_justification: Cannot recompute LE compositions or the energy barrier from lightweight verifier; the simulation requires a full phase-field solver with CALPHAD energies and long runtimes, infeasible in the checker sandbox. Instead compare agent-reported results to paper reference with generous tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference gold values for LE compositions (at.% Nb) and energy barrier (J/mol).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 3 and text: 450°C γ2=79, 550°C γ2=76; 605°C intermediate LE1=24.49, LE2=73.95; barrier 18.65 J/mol from Fig. 4 and text.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported numerical results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values published in the paper; they are the reproduction target.

outputs.description: Local equilibrium γ-phase compositions at 450°C, 550°C, and the two LEs at 605°C.
Peak energy barrier overcome during the forced transition from intermediate LE to stable LE at 605°C.

output_contract.notes: The checker reads each JSON file and compares the reported numerical values against the paper’s hidden gold values using absolute tolerances.

steps.description: Compare each γ composition (at.% Nb) at LE to the paper's values with absolute tolerance ±1 at.% Nb.
Compare the energy barrier (J/mol) to the paper's value with absolute tolerance ±1 J/mol.
